legend.title: MSDAC
legend.text: MULTISECTION DIGITAL AXLE COUNTER (SINGLE DETECTION). Symbol: two double circles on a stem across the rail; labelled OEn / NDn.

legend.title: STOP UNTILL PILOTED
legend.text: Board: box with a cross and four small circles on a post.

notes.text: THE SIGNALLING ARRANGEMENT IS SUITABLE FOR 25KV AC TRACTION.
ALL SIGNAL LAMPS ARE OF LED TYPE.
ALL CHAINAGES ARE SHOWN WITH RESPECT TO CENTRE LINE OF SCMN STATION BUILDING (CSB) AS 0.00M.
ALL POINTS ARE 1 IN 8 1/2 CS.
ALL POINTS ARE MOTOR OPERATED, EXCEPT OTHERWISE INDICATED.
OPERATION OF E.I. IS THROUGH DUAL VDU.
`ON' ASPECT OF UP HOME & DN STR. SIGNALS ARE TO BE PROVED IN RESPECTIVE SLOT CIRCUITS.

AS PER IRSEM/2021, PARA 17.7.5, FOR MSDAC, ZONE VERIFICATION BUTTON'S PROVIDED AT SITE IN LINE VERFICATION BOX / CRANK HANDLE BOX, INSTALLED NEAR THE AXLE COUNTER ZONE. DURING FAILURE OF MSDAC IN STATION YARD, THE RESETTING SHALL BE COOPERATIVE AND DONE JOINTLY BY THE ON DUTY ASM ALONG WITH ANOTHER OPERATING STAFF, WHO SHALL VERIFY PHYSICAL CLEARANCE OF LINE AND PRESS THE ZONE VERIFICATION BUTTON FOR THE FAILED TRACK SECTION OF AXLE COUNTER.

DURING FAILURE OF MSDAC BETWEEN OEC- E CABIN BLOCK SECTION, SM/OEC WILL RESET THE 'MSDAC' AFTER RECEIVING THE RESET-PERMISSION FROM SM/'E' CABIN, AFTER ENSURING THAT NO TRAIN IS AVAILABLE IN THE BLOCK SECTION.

ALL STARTER/SHUNT SIGNALS ARE PLACED AT 3M FROM CONCERNED AXLE COUNTER DETECTION DEVICE & 3 SEC TIME DELAY TO BE PROVIDED IN HR CIRCUIT AS PER RAILWAY BOARD LETTER No. 2012/SIG/SEM-II/MISC, DT 10.10.2012.
VIDE S.R -1.03.01(a) OEC YARD IS A 'SPECIAL CLASS STATION'.
SLOT GRANTED OR RECEIVED SHALL PROVE DESTINATION SIGNAL NO LIGHT PROTECTION.
FOR EVERY SLOT GRANTED OR RECEIVED IT SHOULD BE SUPPORTED WITH PN NUMBER EXCHANGE BETWEEN THE CONCERNED SM'S.
ONCE SLOT IS GRANTED BY SM/OEC, DURING ITS WITHDRAWL IT SHOULD BE SUPPORTED WITH DEAD APPROACH LOCKING OF 120 SECONDS.

PCOM/ECOR/BBS's SPECIAL INSTRUCTION IS OBTAINED VIDE NO. ECOR/OPTG/SC/55/XV/Spl.Inst/WMY, DATED-23.12.2021, THAT ''FOR SHUNTING MOVEMENTS ON NON-ISOLATED LINES, 120 METERS GAP BETWEEN THE PATH OF TRAINS IS NOT REQUIRED IN TERMS WITH RLY BOARD'S LETTER NO.2008/SAFETY(A&R)/19/5. DTD.14.05.2010 AND AS PER SUBSIDIARY RULES SR.5.16.01 OF EAST COAST RAILWAY''.

PCOM/ECOR/BBS'S/SPECIAL INSTRUCTIONS OBTAINED VIDE ECOR/OPTG/SC/55/XV/Spl.Inst/WMY, DATED-23.12.2021, IN TERMS OF GR 3.47, FOR ALLOWING SIMULTANEOUS RECEPTION OR DISPATCH OF TRAINS WHEN TWO OR MORE TRAINS ARE APPROACHING SIMULTANEOUSLY FROM ANY DIRECTION, KEEPING 120MTRS OF PHYSICAL SEPERATION BEING A GOODS YARD.

AS PER PCOM/ECOR/BBS's SPECIAL INSTRUCTION IS OBTAINED VIDE ECOR/OPTG/SC/55/XV/Spl.Inst/WMY, DATED-23.12.2021, THIS YARD IS TERMED AS TERMINAL YARD WITH 15KMPH RESTICTION, HENCE ADEQUATE SIGNAL OVERLAP FOR RECEPTION OF TRAINS ARE DISPENSED WITH IN TERMS OF G.R. 3.40(I).
THE MOVEMENTS TO/FROM OEC AND WESTERN SECTOR CONNECTING LINE WILL BE THROUGH PN EXCHANGE AFTER ENSURING NO TRAIN IN THE SECTION BY SM/OEC AND SM/WESTERN SECTOR.
FOR DISPATCHING TRAINS FROM LOAD GRID & EMPTY GRID TO DUMPER CABIN, WILL BE DONE THROUGH PN EXCHANGE AFTER ENSURING NO TRAIN IN THE SECTION AND NO CROSS MOVEMENT IN WESTERN SECTOR TO VPT/ECABIN.
SIGNALS - S(28.30.32.34.36.38.40).(42.44.46.48.50.52)A. SH62B. ARE RELEASED BY SLOT-5 OF 'F' CABIN TO DISPATCH TRAINS TO KK LINE.
SIGNALS - S/SH(42.44.46.48.50.52)B ARE RELEASED BY SLOT-1 OF 'F' CABIN TO DISPATCH TRAINS TO E.Co.Rly LINE.
SIGNALS - SH(60, 62A) ARE RELEASED BY SLOT-'X' OF 'F' CABIN TO DISPATCH TRAINS TO ELS ENGINE LINE.
SIGNALS - SH65A IS RELEASED BY SLOT-3 OF E CABIN TO DISPATCH TRAINS TO BULB LINE.
SIGNALS - SH65B ARE RELEASED BY SLOT-13 OF VPT R&D YARD.

SLOT-71 OF OEC IS TRANSMITTED TO 'F' CABIN FOR RECEIVING TRAIN FROM ELS ENGINE LINE.
SLOT-72 OF OEC GRANTED TO DUMPER CABIN FOR RECEIVING TRAIN FROM VPT LINE.
SLOT-73 OF OEC IS TRANSMITTED TO 'F' CABIN FOR RECEIVING TRAIN FROM KK LINE.

SLOT-74 OF OEC IS TRANSMITTED TO E CABIN (BULB LINE) FOR RECEIVING TRAIN FROM BULB LINE.
SLOT-41 OF DUMPER CABIN IS TRANSMITTED TO VPT R&D YARD FOR RECEIVING TRAINS FROM VPT R&D YARD.
SLOT-43 OF DUMPER CABIN IS TRANSMITTED TO OEC YARD FOR RECEIVING TRAINS FROM BULB LINE.
SLOT-45 OF DUMPER CABIN IS TRANSMITTED TO OEC YARD FOR UNLOCKING POINTS 102A/B &104A/B.
SLOT-13 OF VPT R&D YARD IS TRANSMITTED TO OEC YARD /DUMPER CABIN FOR DISPATCHING TRAINS FROM OEC/DUMPER CABIN TO VPT R&D YARD.

FOR A TRAIN MOVEMENT BETWEEN DUMPER CABIN AND WESTERN SECTOR CONNECTING PORT IT SHOULD BE THROUGH PN EXCHANGE AFTER ENSURING THAT NO TRAIN IS AVAILABLE BETWEEN DUMPER CABIN AND WESTERN SECTOR CONNECTING PORT.
LEGEND: MSDAC- MULTISECTION DIGITAL AXLE COUNTER (SINGLE DETECTION); STOP UNTILL PILOTED.
ENTIRE YARD IS PROVIDED WITH SINGLE DETECTION MSDAC.
SOD CLEARANCE TO BE ENSURED BY FIELD STAFF FOR PLACING/SHIFTING OF SIGNALS AT A DISTANCE OF )M-#M FROM THE BOUNDARY OF REPLACEMENT TRACK DETECTION POINT.

procedures.title: WORKING OF POINT NO's:102A/B & 104A/B:
steps: 1.NORMALLY POINTS 102A/B & 104A/B REMAIN IN LOCKED CONDITION. THESE TWO POINTS 102A/B & 104A/B ARE OPERATED BY SM/OEC YARD.

2.FOR OPERATION OF POINTS 102A/B & 104A/B FROM NORMAL TO REVERSE OR REVERSE TO NORMAL, POINTS GETS UNLOCKED AFTER GETTING SLOT CONTROL-'45' (KEY-A) FROM DUMPER CABIN TRANSMITTED ELECTRICALLY THROUGH RKT.
3.AFTER OPERATION OF THESE POINTS TO REQUIRED POSITION, SLOT CONTROL '45' (KEY-'A') OF DUMBER CABIN IS WITHDRAWN AND AT DUMPER CABIN KEY 'A' IS RETURNED IN RESPECTIVE RKT.
4.KEY IN CONTACT OF RKT ARE PROVIDED IN CONCERNED HR/SLOT CIRCUITS.
